Alpha 1.79.38 (Character preparation)

  • Improved background preparation of equipped characters while preserving their model detail, material boundaries and animation data.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.37 (Forge and merchant keyboard controls)

  • Forge gems and sockets support Tab, Enter and Space with named choices, clear selection and unavailable states, visible focus and larger touch targets.
  • Forge refreshes preserve your reading position and follow the same focused item when lists reorder. Changed equipment clears old spending choices before another operation.
  • Merchant buyback shows item names, quantities and total Gold prices. Keyboard focus stays with the current item through refreshes; removed or invalid choices cannot send an outdated action.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Improved combat stability when basic attacks land during spell casts.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.36 (Earth ground and Chronicle details)

  • Earth's open ground gains short dry thatch, while planted beds show living grass. Color, roughness and shallow relief share the same surface pattern; roads, forest litter and standing vegetation keep their existing layout.
  • Chronicle investigation and hunt items have distinct drawn symbols in item views, with clear shapes on desktop and phones.
  • Content checks now verify generated catalogs and animation inventories without rewriting them during installation or validation.
  • Terrain checks cover visible rock formations and dungeon checkpoint returns on both configured terrain profiles. Raised terrain remains disabled in the public world.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • This ground-material improvement does not establish final world-art quality or whole-game performance. Earlier frame, draw and triangle limits remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.35 (Build and trade reviews)

  • Direct trade keeps your item and Gold draft when your partner updates their offer. Confirm becomes available after your submitted offer is acknowledged, so the offer you review matches the one you confirm.
  • Trade actions are easier to reach on phones, with larger controls, readable Gold entry and a scrollable panel above the combat controls.
  • Desktop skill unlocks and rune choices support Tab, Enter and Space. Build updates retain your focused choice and reading position while you stay in the same view.
  • Guild calendar actions stay tied to the current plan and membership. Finding a group from a calendar card opens at the activity filters.
  • The VIP venue dialog has a clearer accessible name and more readable unavailable actions.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking, separate automation-account population reporting and the complete earlier patch history through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.34 (Steady navigation and weapon grips)

  • The dungeon radar keeps entrance-room walls and corridor openings in view. Its scale stays steady while walking and advancing through the instance.
  • Rogues carrying different weapons keep each hand's own grip while resting, walking, running and blocking. Alternating attacks retain the corresponding main-hand and off-hand weapon motions.
  • Character preparation copies supplied geometry more efficiently while preserving the original models and visible detail. This improves a measured preparation step; whole-game frame-rate and device qualification remain in progress.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking, separate automation-account population reporting, account help and the expanded Player Guide.
  • Existing accounts, saved progression and access remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.33 (Player help and recovery)

  • Account / Progress Help is available after signing in, before entering the world, and from the in-game report form. Account help keeps nearby-player context and optional diagnostics off.
  • The Player Guide adds expandable chapters covering equipment and classes, parties, dungeons and raids, crafting and repairs, Gold and Eidolon Points, and settings and accessibility.
  • Optional lore now scrolls independently beneath its close control, with keyboard access to the full text. Bellkeeper’s Cairn gains a short continuation about the crystal’s promise of shelter.
  • Birch crowns have connected, overlapping boughs and fuller upper growth while retaining their existing roots, placements and leaf counts.
  • Coordinated backup checks identify damaged or incomplete recovery sets before restoration begins.
  • Includes fitted town roofs, shared ground-cover geometry, woodland and rock surfaces, equipped motion and sound, approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • World art and whole-party performance remain in progress. Existing accounts, saved progression and access remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.32 (Town construction and world resources)

  • Lanternhold’s smithy and Gilded Compact gain fitted roof ends and timber edge boards, closing gaps above their stone walls.
  • Earth ground cover uses less duplicated geometry memory and releases its resources correctly when changing areas or graphics quality. Plant density, shapes and lighting are retained.
  • Earth outcrops gain distinct geological faces and worn ledges within the existing raised-terrain profile.
  • Includes the preceding woodland surfaces, scene rendering, dungeon stonework, equipped motions, contact sounds and status symbols.
  • Includes approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • World art and whole-party performance remain in progress. Raised terrain retains the operator-selected profile. Existing accounts, saved progression and access remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.31 (Woodland surfaces and scene rendering)

  • Earth rock shelves gain worn, connected shoulders and continuous moss shading. Ferns gain curved, tapered leaflets with smooth folds, and woodland ground cover responds more naturally to light and shadow.
  • Pine boughs gain fuller needle sprays, varied growth and coherent needle tones. Earth soil, moss, fallen leaves and stone blend color, roughness and surface relief in the same order.
  • High graphics smooths scene edges after brightness and tone mapping, preserving the intended colors and bloom.
  • Improved rendering of roadside camps and Demon Orcs reduces unnecessary scene submissions on supported devices. High graphics also groups supported rigid actors more efficiently.
  • Includes the preceding dungeon stonework, entrance wards, regional relics, equipped skill motions, contact sounds and clear status symbols.
  • Includes approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • World art, whole-party performance and physical-device review remain in progress. Raised terrain retains the operator-selected profile. Saved accounts, progression and access remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.30 (Grounded dungeons and equipped combat)

  • Dungeons gain worn stone and metal surfaces, grounded entrance wards, processional paving, regional relics and shallow mapped boss floors. The existing arena layout, room rules and walking boundaries remain.
  • Equipped class skills gain shield, heavy, sweep, spin and throw motions. Wizard releases use the supplied cast animation; receiving damage preserves remote attack and cast continuity.
  • Physical, fire, cold, lightning and shadow impacts gain short textured contact sounds. Periodic damage stays quieter, with existing combat volume, mute and warning priority controls.
  • Status effects use clear consistent symbols on desktop and phone. World and atlas surfaces gain regional detail, and prepared equipment geometry reduces work when presenting supplied outfits.
  • Includes the approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting from the preceding maintenance releases.
  • Saved accounts, progression and access remain unchanged. This milestone does not mark final world art, whole-party performance, physical-device feedback or closed-beta approval complete. Raised terrain retains the operator-selected profile. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.29 (Complete jump pose continuity)

  • Removed a remaining pose snap as characters untuck midway through a jump. Takeoff, roll and landing now ease smoothly between poses.
  • Starting a jump retires any earlier walking correction, preventing a pull back toward takeoff after landing.
  • The first server acknowledgement now renders the current jump position immediately, eliminating a brief backward snap at takeoff.
  • Includes smooth jump prediction and sparse network updates, the Well Rested aura tracking fix and correct separation of automation accounts in administration.
  • Long jumps retain 1.3 seconds of flight for approximately 1.5-second total arrival. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.
